userRole.handler: Responsible for managing the ingredients in the kitchen’s inventory and dispensers.
userRole.manager: Responsible for managing the purchases, ensuring the availability of ingredients, and maintaining supplier records.
userRole.admin: Control and oversight over all aspects of the platform, ensuring security, user management, and system configuration.

userRestrictions.handler: No access to reports, purchases and suppliers.
userRestrictions.manager: Cannot change anything in the inventory and dispensers.
